Path: business reporting | dashboards.chart-type-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade (held: no `reach:`) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:on-hold` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` (the find leg's `aggregateRecords` keys raw records on the group COLUMN, `alias || field`, and does no date bucketing) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: on a data source with no `aggregate()`, an `alias` groupBy draws one `Unknown` bar and a `dateGranularity` groupBy draws one bar per raw timestamp. It was read at source only. No in-repo provider lacks `aggregate()`, and no real producer is named, so it has no `reach:` and none of the three exceptions applies ⇒ p3. The current gate does not dispatch such a finding on its own, and no closure card exists for this family, so it is held rather than queued, and ⛔ not closed.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:43Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Restart-when: a real data source without `aggregate()` is named, or a wrong picture is measured through a public door, or a second find-leg finding opens (this card then becomes that family's closure card).

Execution note, for when it restarts: bucket as the engine does (read the source `field`, key the row by `alias || field`, apply `dateGranularity` with the server's boundaries), or refuse the alias and date forms on the find leg loudly. Pin both forms against the `aggregate()` path. PR objectui#10673, which the filer named as serial, has merged.
